activity_summary: At rehearsal you were a line early on the third entrance, because father is said twice and only the second is your cue. You play the old man with the message at two, and you did not name him. Augustine Phillips set eight bars under the entrance instead of four, and no new song. Garnish marked the plot and refused to rewrite the book for one morning.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the later cue and refused a name for the part.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Named the early line, marked the plot, and left the book.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Argued for the early laugh, and then waited the line.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Set eight bars and refused a new song.

facets.activity: Rehearsed the old man's cue on the second father

topics: a book left as it is

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: The strain under that entrance is eight bars.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: What I play at two is the old man with the message.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: I will not rewrite the book for one morning.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: Two fathers, and only one of them is yours.
